reason: Both sell subscription-based lead generation, SEO and digital marketing to local businesses. They differ in the core product and the customer vertical. Thryv sells a small-business management SaaS platform plus done-for-you marketing to home and local service providers. Cars.com runs a consumer car marketplace and sells listings, advertising and software to car dealers and automakers. Overlap exists in marketing services and local-business customers, but it is not full overlap in both.
